title: Father with Shears and Toddler in Backyard, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny black-and-white snapshot depicting a loving father crouching beside his toddler daughter in a grassy backyard. The smiling man wears a white crewneck t-shirt and dark trousers while holding large hedge shears near a small flowerbed. His young daughter stands upright in a pale matching playsuit, socks, and shoes. A rustic wooden fence, laundry on an overhead clothesline, and residential homes frame the background, capturing post-war domestic suburban life in 1950s America.
